subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should an explicitly configured TTS provider remain fallback-capable, or should OpenClaw fail loudly instead of playing audio from a different configured provider?
rationale: Current code, docs, and tests make provider fallback intentional, but this issue shows that behavior can surprise users and obscure provider billing or voice identity.

options.title: Preserve fallback default
options.body: Keep the documented fallback chain as the default and rely on /tts status diagnostics unless maintainers approve a separate sticky-provider policy.

options.title: Fail closed for explicit provider
options.body: Change auto-TTS and /tts audio so an explicit configured provider failure reports the failure instead of playing a fallback provider.

options.title: Add opt-in strict mode
options.body: Add a deliberate product surface for provider stickiness only if maintainers accept the extra config and upgrade complexity.

recommendation.title: Preserve fallback default
recommendation.body: Keep the documented fallback chain as the default and rely on /tts status diagnostics unless maintainers approve a separate sticky-provider policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The history points to broad TTS/provider ownership and prior provider policy work, making this the best available product-direction owner.
